All operations are confined to standard build and packaging activities.

The package depends only on legitimate Python libraries used by the application, and the maintainer-provided files (`decky-loader@.service`, `decky-loader-helper`) are installed directly and transparently. No `eval`, `curl|bash`, or other dangerous patterns are present. The use of `sed` is limited to necessary build and path configuration changes and does not introduce remote code execution risks.
